# Sample 1 (LockSample)
  Q1 lock 0, lock 100 [horizon, 250ms]: stores {"locked":true,"pulses":1,"shutdowns":0}
      0ms >> requests.request(true)
      0ms state powered
      0ms state unlocked
      0ms locked = false
      0ms state locking (via 1/3/1/then/0)
      0ms send motor.lockMotor("lockPulse")
      100ms >> requests.request(true)
      100ms stay locking
      250ms send motor.lockMotor("idle")
      250ms state isLocked (via 1/4/2/body/0)
      250ms locked = true
  Q2 lock 0, unlock 100 [horizon, 500ms]: stores {"locked":false,"pulses":2,"shutdowns":0}
      0ms >> requests.request(true)
      0ms state powered
      0ms state unlocked
      0ms locked = false
      0ms state locking (via 1/3/1/then/0)
      0ms send motor.lockMotor("lockPulse")
      100ms >> requests.request(false)
      100ms stay locking
      250ms send motor.lockMotor("idle")
      250ms state isLocked (via 1/4/2/body/0)
      250ms locked = true
      250ms state unlocking (via 1/5/1/then/0)
      250ms send motor.lockMotor("unlockPulse")
      500ms send motor.lockMotor("idle")
      500ms state unlocked (via 1/6/2/body/0)
      500ms locked = false
  Q3 lock 0, query 100 [horizon, 250ms]: stores {"locked":true,"pulses":1,"shutdowns":0}
      0ms >> requests.request(true)
      0ms state powered
      0ms state unlocked
      0ms locked = false
      0ms state locking (via 1/3/1/then/0)
      0ms send motor.lockMotor("lockPulse")
      100ms >> status.query()
      100ms publish status.report(false, 1)
      100ms stay locking
      250ms send motor.lockMotor("idle")
      250ms state isLocked (via 1/4/2/body/0)
      250ms locked = true
  Q4 lock 0, unlock 100, off 300 [quiescent, 300ms]: stores {"locked":true,"pulses":2,"shutdowns":1}
      0ms >> requests.request(true)
      0ms state powered
      0ms state unlocked
      0ms locked = false
      0ms state locking (via 1/3/1/then/0)
      0ms send motor.lockMotor("lockPulse")
      100ms >> requests.request(false)
      100ms stay locking
      250ms send motor.lockMotor("idle")
      250ms state isLocked (via 1/4/2/body/0)
      250ms locked = true
      250ms state unlocking (via 1/5/1/then/0)
      250ms send motor.lockMotor("unlockPulse")
      300ms >> power.off()
      300ms send motor.lockMotor("idle")
      300ms control completes
  Q5 off, then lock [quiescent, 10ms]: stores {"locked":false,"pulses":0,"shutdowns":1}
      0ms >> power.off()
      0ms state powered
      0ms state unlocked
      0ms locked = false
      0ms control completes
      10ms >> requests.request(true)
      10ms discard requests.request (inactiveOwner)
      10ms >> status.query()
      10ms discard status.query (inactiveOwner)
# Sample 2 (TrafficSample)
  Q1 press at 3s [horizon, 40s]: stores {}
      0ms state green
      0ms send lamps.set("green")
      0ms state minimum
      3s >> ped.button()
      3s stay minimum
      10s state extended (via 1/body/0/3/0/body/0)
      10s state yellow
      10s send lamps.set("yellow")
      13s state red
      13s send lamps.set("red")
      15s state walk
      15s send walkSign.set(true)
      30s send walkSign.set(false)
      30s state green
      30s send lamps.set("green")
      30s state minimum
      40s state extended (via 1/body/0/3/0/body/0)
  Q2 press at 20s [horizon, 50s]: stores {}
      0ms state green
      0ms send lamps.set("green")
      0ms state minimum
      10s state extended (via 1/body/0/3/0/body/0)
      20s >> ped.button()
      20s state yellow
      20s send lamps.set("yellow")
      23s state red
      23s send lamps.set("red")
      25s state walk
      25s send walkSign.set(true)
      40s send walkSign.set(false)
      40s state green
      40s send lamps.set("green")
      40s state minimum
      50s state extended (via 1/body/0/3/0/body/0)
  Q3 no press [horizon, 140s]: stores {}
      0ms state green
      0ms send lamps.set("green")
      0ms state minimum
      10s state extended (via 1/body/0/3/0/body/0)
      60s state yellow
      60s send lamps.set("yellow")
      63s state red
      63s send lamps.set("red")
      65s state green
      65s send lamps.set("green")
      65s state minimum
      75s state extended (via 1/body/0/3/0/body/0)
      125s state yellow
      125s send lamps.set("yellow")
      128s state red
      128s send lamps.set("red")
      130s state green
      130s send lamps.set("green")
      130s state minimum
      140s state extended (via 1/body/0/3/0/body/0)
  Q4 press at 3s and during walk (25s) [horizon, 95s]: stores {}
      0ms state green
      0ms send lamps.set("green")
      0ms state minimum
      3s >> ped.button()
      3s stay minimum
      10s state extended (via 1/body/0/3/0/body/0)
      10s state yellow
      10s send lamps.set("yellow")
      13s state red
      13s send lamps.set("red")
      15s state walk
      15s send walkSign.set(true)
      25s >> ped.button()
      25s discard ped.button (inactiveOwner)
      30s send walkSign.set(false)
      30s state green
      30s send lamps.set("green")
      30s state minimum
      40s state extended (via 1/body/0/3/0/body/0)
      90s state yellow
      90s send lamps.set("yellow")
      93s state red
      93s send lamps.set("red")
      95s state green
      95s send lamps.set("green")
      95s state minimum
  Q5 no press in green, press during yellow (61s) [horizon, 140s]: stores {}
      0ms state green
      0ms send lamps.set("green")
      0ms state minimum
      10s state extended (via 1/body/0/3/0/body/0)
      60s state yellow
      60s send lamps.set("yellow")
      61s >> ped.button()
      61s discard ped.button (inactiveOwner)
      63s state red
      63s send lamps.set("red")
      65s state green
      65s send lamps.set("green")
      65s state minimum
      75s state extended (via 1/body/0/3/0/body/0)
      125s state yellow
      125s send lamps.set("yellow")
      128s state red
      128s send lamps.set("red")
      130s state green
      130s send lamps.set("green")
      130s state minimum
      140s state extended (via 1/body/0/3/0/body/0)
# Sample 3 (ModesFlat)
  Q1 go while off, then ignitionOn [horizon, 10ms]: stores {}
      0ms state off
      0ms send status.mode("off")
      0ms >> cmd.go()
      0ms discard cmd.go (inactiveOwner)
      10ms >> key.ignitionOn()
      10ms state standby
      10ms send status.mode("standby")
  Q2 running; halt and ignitionOff at one instant [horizon, 20ms]: stores {}
      0ms state off
      0ms send status.mode("off")
      0ms >> key.ignitionOn()
      0ms state standby
      0ms send status.mode("standby")
      10ms >> cmd.go()
      10ms state running
      10ms send status.mode("running")
      10ms send drive.enable(true)
      20ms >> cmd.halt()
      20ms >> key.ignitionOff()
      20ms send drive.enable(false)
      20ms state standby (via 0/body/2/3/body/0)
      20ms send status.mode("standby")
      20ms state off (via 0/body/1/1/body/0)
      20ms send status.mode("off")
  Q3 running; diag.enter, then diag.leave [horizon, 30ms]: stores {}
      0ms state off
      0ms send status.mode("off")
      0ms >> key.ignitionOn()
      0ms state standby
      0ms send status.mode("standby")
      10ms >> cmd.go()
      10ms state running
      10ms send status.mode("running")
      10ms send drive.enable(true)
      20ms >> diag.enter()
      20ms send drive.enable(false)
      20ms state diagnostic
      20ms send status.mode("diagnostic")
      30ms >> diag.leave()
      30ms state standby (via 0/body/3/2/body/0)
      30ms send status.mode("standby")
  Q4 standby; diag.leave [horizon, 10ms]: stores {}
      0ms state off
      0ms send status.mode("off")
      0ms >> key.ignitionOn()
      0ms state standby
      0ms send status.mode("standby")
      10ms >> diag.leave()
      10ms discard diag.leave (inactiveOwner)
  Q5 ends? (long run with every input) [horizon, 50ms]: stores {}
      0ms state off
      0ms send status.mode("off")
      0ms >> key.ignitionOn()
      0ms state standby
      0ms send status.mode("standby")
      10ms >> cmd.go()
      10ms state running
      10ms send status.mode("running")
      10ms send drive.enable(true)
      20ms >> key.ignitionOff()
      20ms send drive.enable(false)
      20ms state off (via 0/body/2/2/body/0)
      20ms send status.mode("off")
      30ms >> key.ignitionOn()
      30ms state standby
      30ms send status.mode("standby")
      40ms >> diag.enter()
      40ms state diagnostic (via 0/body/1/3/body/0)
      40ms send status.mode("diagnostic")
      50ms >> key.ignitionOff()
      50ms state off (via 0/body/3/1/body/0)
      50ms send status.mode("off")
# Sample 4 (ConnSample)
  Q1 no answer [horizon, 30.62s]: stores {}
      0ms publish link.hello(1)
      0ms state awaiting
      10ms publish link.hello(2)
      10ms state awaiting
      30ms publish link.hello(3)
      30ms state awaiting
      70ms publish link.hello(4)
      70ms state awaiting
      150ms publish link.hello(5)
      150ms state awaiting
      310ms state cooldown
      30.31s publish link.hello(1)
      30.31s state awaiting
      30.32s publish link.hello(2)
      30.32s state awaiting
      30.34s publish link.hello(3)
      30.34s state awaiting
      30.38s publish link.hello(4)
      30.38s state awaiting
      30.46s publish link.hello(5)
      30.46s state awaiting
      30.62s state cooldown
  Q2 late ack(1) at 12ms [horizon, 70ms]: stores {}
      0ms publish link.hello(1)
      0ms state awaiting
      10ms publish link.hello(2)
      10ms state awaiting
      12ms >> link.ack(1)
      12ms discard c.manage (noEnabledTransition)
      30ms publish link.hello(3)
      30ms state awaiting
      70ms publish link.hello(4)
      70ms state awaiting
  Q3 ack(2) at 30ms [horizon, 70ms]: stores {}
      0ms publish link.hello(1)
      0ms state awaiting
      10ms publish link.hello(2)
      10ms state awaiting
      30ms >> link.ack(2)
      30ms publish link.hello(3)
      30ms state awaiting
      30ms discard c.manage (noEnabledTransition)
      70ms publish link.hello(4)
      70ms state awaiting
  Q4 ack(1) at 5ms, down at 50ms [horizon, 60ms]: stores {}
      0ms publish link.hello(1)
      0ms state awaiting
      5ms >> link.ack(1)
      5ms state connected
      5ms publish status.connected(true)
      50ms >> link.down()
      50ms publish status.connected(false)
      50ms publish link.hello(1)
      50ms state awaiting
      60ms publish link.hello(2)
      60ms state awaiting
  Q5 ack during cooldown (1s) [horizon, 1s]: stores {}
      0ms publish link.hello(1)
      0ms state awaiting
      10ms publish link.hello(2)
      10ms state awaiting
      30ms publish link.hello(3)
      30ms state awaiting
      70ms publish link.hello(4)
      70ms state awaiting
      150ms publish link.hello(5)
      150ms state awaiting
      310ms state cooldown
      1s >> link.ack(1)
      1s discard link.ack (inactiveOwner)
# Sample 5 (DebounceSample)
  Q1 true 0, false 5, true 8 [horizon, 28ms]: stores {}
      0ms state low
      0ms >> sw.level(true)
      0ms state risingCheck
      5ms >> sw.level(false)
      5ms state low (via 0/body/1/0/body/0/then/0)
      8ms >> sw.level(true)
      8ms state risingCheck
      28ms publish out.pressed()
      28ms state high
  Q2 true 0, true 10 [horizon, 20ms]: stores {}
      0ms state low
      0ms >> sw.level(true)
      0ms state risingCheck
      10ms >> sw.level(true)
      10ms discard c.debounce (noEnabledTransition)
      20ms publish out.pressed()
      20ms state high
  Q3 true 0, false 20 [horizon, 40ms]: stores {}
      0ms state low
      0ms >> sw.level(true)
      0ms state risingCheck
      20ms publish out.pressed()
      20ms state high
      20ms >> sw.level(false)
      20ms state fallingCheck
      40ms publish out.released()
      40ms state low
  Q4 false in low [horizon, 0ms]: stores {}
      0ms state low
      0ms >> sw.level(false)
      0ms discard c.debounce (noEnabledTransition)
  Q5 pressed; false 100, true 105, false 110 [horizon, 130ms]: stores {}
      0ms state low
      0ms >> sw.level(true)
      0ms state risingCheck
      20ms publish out.pressed()
      20ms state high
      100ms >> sw.level(false)
      100ms state fallingCheck
      105ms >> sw.level(true)
      105ms state high (via 0/body/3/0/body/0/then/0)
      110ms >> sw.level(false)
      110ms state fallingCheck
      130ms publish out.released()
      130ms state low
# Sample 6 (OwnerSample)
  Q1 go(false) [horizon, 0ms]: stores {"processed":0,"reported":0}
      0ms >> cmd.go(false)
      0ms state state0
      0ms send lamp.set("waiting")
      0ms state state1
      0ms send lamp.set("retry")
  Q2 retry 5ms, go(false) 10ms [horizon, 10ms]: stores {"processed":0,"reported":0}
      0ms state state0
      0ms send lamp.set("waiting")
      5ms >> cmd.retry()
      5ms discard cmd.retry (inactiveOwner)
      10ms >> cmd.go(false)
      10ms state state1
      10ms send lamp.set("retry")
  Q3 go(true) 0, go 5ms [quiescent, 10ms]: stores {"processed":1,"reported":1}
      0ms >> cmd.go(true)
      0ms state state0
      0ms send lamp.set("waiting")
      0ms state state2
      0ms send lamp.set("go")
      5ms >> cmd.go(true)
      5ms discard cmd.go (inactiveOwner)
      10ms state state4
      10ms run completes
  Q4 go(true) 0: when process() [quiescent, 10ms]: stores {"processed":1,"reported":1}
      0ms >> cmd.go(true)
      0ms state state0
      0ms send lamp.set("waiting")
      0ms state state2
      0ms send lamp.set("go")
      10ms state state4
      10ms run completes
  Q5 after state4: go again [quiescent, 50ms]: stores {"processed":1,"reported":1}
      0ms >> cmd.go(true)
      0ms state state0
      0ms send lamp.set("waiting")
      0ms state state2
      0ms send lamp.set("go")
      10ms state state4
      10ms run completes
      50ms >> cmd.go(true)
      50ms discard cmd.go (inactiveOwner)
      50ms >> cmd.retry()
      50ms discard cmd.retry (inactiveOwner)
# Sample 7 (ModesParent)
  Q1 running; ecu.shutdown [quiescent, 30ms]: stores {}
      0ms state system
      0ms state off
      0ms send status.mode("off")
      0ms >> key.ignitionOn()
      0ms state powered (via 0/1/1/body/0)
      0ms state standby (via 0/1/1/body/0)
      0ms send status.mode("standby")
      10ms >> cmd.go()
      10ms state running (via 0/2/1/1/body/0)
      10ms send status.mode("running")
      10ms send drive.enable(true)
      20ms >> ecu.shutdown()
      20ms send drive.enable(false)
      20ms send status.mode("off")
      20ms modes completes
      30ms >> key.ignitionOn()
      30ms discard key.ignitionOn (inactiveOwner)
  Q2 diagnostic; ignitionOff [horizon, 20ms]: stores {}
      0ms state system
      0ms state off
      0ms send status.mode("off")
      0ms >> key.ignitionOn()
      0ms state powered (via 0/1/1/body/0)
      0ms state standby (via 0/1/1/body/0)
      0ms send status.mode("standby")
      10ms >> diag.enter()
      10ms state diagnostic (via 0/2/1/2/body/0)
      10ms send status.mode("diagnostic")
      20ms >> key.ignitionOff()
      20ms state off (via 0/2/0/body/0)
      20ms send status.mode("off")
  Q3 standby; cmd.halt [horizon, 10ms]: stores {}
      0ms state system
      0ms state off
      0ms send status.mode("off")
      0ms >> key.ignitionOn()
      0ms state powered (via 0/1/1/body/0)
      0ms state standby (via 0/1/1/body/0)
      0ms send status.mode("standby")
      10ms >> cmd.halt()
      10ms discard cmd.halt (inactiveOwner)
  Q4 running; halt, go, ignitionOff at one instant [horizon, 20ms]: stores {}
      0ms state system
      0ms state off
      0ms send status.mode("off")
      0ms >> key.ignitionOn()
      0ms state powered (via 0/1/1/body/0)
      0ms state standby (via 0/1/1/body/0)
      0ms send status.mode("standby")
      10ms >> cmd.go()
      10ms state running (via 0/2/1/1/body/0)
      10ms send status.mode("running")
      10ms send drive.enable(true)
      20ms >> cmd.halt()
      20ms >> cmd.go()
      20ms send drive.enable(false)
      20ms >> key.ignitionOff()
      20ms state standby (via 0/2/2/2/body/0)
      20ms send status.mode("standby")
      20ms state running (via 0/2/1/1/body/0)
      20ms send status.mode("running")
      20ms send drive.enable(true)
      20ms send drive.enable(false)
      20ms state off (via 0/2/0/body/0)
      20ms send status.mode("off")
  Q4b running; same three queued while the machine is busy (delivered at one instant before it waits) [quiescent, 10ms]: stores {}
      0ms state system
      0ms state off
      0ms send status.mode("off")
      0ms >> key.ignitionOn()
      0ms >> cmd.go()
      0ms state powered (via 0/1/1/body/0)
      0ms state standby (via 0/1/1/body/0)
      0ms send status.mode("standby")
      0ms state running (via 0/2/1/1/body/0)
      0ms send status.mode("running")
      0ms send drive.enable(true)
      10ms >> cmd.halt()
      10ms >> cmd.go()
      10ms send drive.enable(false)
      10ms >> key.ignitionOff()
      10ms state standby (via 0/2/2/2/body/0)
      10ms send status.mode("standby")
      10ms >> ecu.shutdown()
      10ms state running (via 0/2/1/1/body/0)
      10ms send status.mode("running")
      10ms send drive.enable(true)
      10ms send drive.enable(false)
      10ms state off (via 0/2/0/body/0)
      10ms send status.mode("off")
      10ms send status.mode("off")
      10ms modes completes
  Q5 shutdown from off [quiescent, 0ms]: stores {}
      0ms state system
      0ms state off
      0ms send status.mode("off")
      0ms >> ecu.shutdown()
      0ms send status.mode("off")
      0ms modes completes
